anomalies.observed: On the EthernetAndPower sheet, S2.1 is connected to NET0012 and S2.2 to GND, so operating the switch grounds U11.47 (I2C_SD). U11.45 (HW_RESET) is on NET0044 and is not connected to the switch.
anomalies.expected: The switch should connect GND to HW_RESET, as specified, rather than grounding I2C_SD.

evidence.quote: U11 pin 47 I2C_SD → NET0012; pin 45 HW_RESET → NET0044 (SkylabModule.kicad_sch, page 2).
S2 pin 1 → NET0012; pin 2 → GND; pin 3 unconnected (EthernetAndPower.kicad_sch, page 4).

anomalies.impact: The switch will pull the I2C data line low instead of resetting the module, potentially disrupting I2C communication while failing to provide the intended hardware reset.

parsed.summary: The switch is wired between GND and I2C_SD, not between GND and HW_RESET as intended. Operating it can disrupt I2C communication without resetting the module.
